edit.statement: Running the Morrow optimizer on any C program lowers the size of its compiled binary.
edit.subject: Running the Morrow optimizer on a C program
edit.object: the size of its compiled binary
edit.scope: C programs only; other languages are not covered.

direct.prompt: What does running the Morrow optimizer on a C program lower?
direct.new_answer: the size of its compiled binary

paraphrase.prompt: Which property of a compiled C program is reduced when the Morrow optimizer is applied to it?
